subject: Including automatically generated HTML on startup

messages.author: bda90bcea347c4f0
messages.subject: Including automatically generated HTML on startup
parts:
I'm using rCharts to dynamically generate Rickshaw charts based on shiny inputs.
This package essentially just generates the HTML and javascript for you, so I'm writing that out to a file each time an input changes and then referencing that .html file in ui.R:

  mainPanel(
    includeHTML("/Users/tanyacashorali/Documents/Scripts/Shiny/Benchmarking/chart.html"),
  width="1000")
))  

However, on startup the file does not yet exist but I'd like it to default to using the inputs that are already specified. Is there a way to tell Shiny not to evaluate the ui.R code until a function returns in server.R?

Thank you for any help.

messages.author: bda90bcea347c4f0
messages.subject: Re: Including automatically generated HTML on startup
parts: A better question might be how do I run a function in server.R on startup that depends on reactive inputs and also run the same function whenever any inputs change that alter the data? Since I'm only using includeHTML and a generated chart.html file, I don't have an output variable to reference.

messages.author: bda90bcea347c4f0
messages.subject: Re: Including automatically generated HTML on startup
parts:
Sorry for replying again, but I've figured out how to associate a generated html page with an output object by using uiOutput("plot") in ui.R.
I can confirm that the chart.html file is updating as the user changes input values, but for some reason none of the HTML is being pulled into Shiny. I had previously seen all of the HTML when I viewed the source and now it's just an empty 'plot' div.  Here's a portion of my server.R code:

output$plot <- renderUI({
    createPlot()
    HTML(readLines("www/chart.html", warn=FALSE))
  })

  createPlot <- reactive({
      d1 <- getData1()
      d2 <- getData2()
      d1$THE_DATE <- as.numeric(as.POSIXct(d1$THE_DATE))
      d2$THE_DATE <- as.numeric(as.POSIXct(d2$THE_DATE))
      forChart <- rbind(d1[,c('THE_DATE', 'Var1', 'winShare')], d2[,c('THE_DATE', 'Var1', 'winShare')])
      p4 <- Rickshaw$new()
      p4$layer(winShare ~ THE_DATE, group = "Var1", data = forChart, type = "line", width = 560)
      
      sink(file="www/chart.html")
      template <- system("cat template.txt", intern=TRUE)
      cat(template)
      cat(p4$print("chart6"))
      sink()
      })
})

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Including automatically generated HTML on startup
parts:
You won't see it in View Source, since that only reflects what was in the page at the time that the page first loaded. Instead, use the browser's built-in DOM inspection tools (instructions for Chrome, for Firefox).

I'm not sure but maybe you need HTML(readLines(...)) to be HTML(paste(readlines(...), collapse="\n")) ?
